name: propanoyl chloride
hypothesis: Like the acetyl chloride family, amine acylation on SiNx outpaces silanol esterification; the literature shows it does react with SiO2 silanols at 230 C, so the selective window, if any, is kinetic and temperature-limited.
falsification: Computed Ea(SiO2) - Ea(SiNx) <= 0, or no practical dose window at 373-523 K.

literature.title: Gas Phase Organic Functionalization of SiO2 with Propanoyl Chloride
literature.quote: At 230 °C, C2H5COCl reacts with isolated surface -SiOH groups to form the expected ester linkage.

literature.title: An experiment-calibrated in-silico AI co-scientist discovers chemoselective silicon-nitride passivation for area-selective SiO2 atomic layer deposition
literature.quote: We hypothesize that a smallmolecule electrophilic inhibitor chemoselectively acylates SiN surface amines

name: BDMADMS
hypothesis: Bis(dimethylamino)dimethylsilane, an aminosilane used to functionalize SiO2 with DMATMS, should share DMATMS's oxide preference (a wrong-direction reference for SiNx blocking).
falsification: Computed Ea(SiO2) - Ea(SiNx) > 0 (faster capping of the nitride).

literature.title: Functionalization of the SiO2 Surface with Aminosilanes to Enable Area-Selective Atomic Layer Deposition of Al2O3
literature.quote: The SiO2 surface was prefunctionalized with bis(dimethylamino)dimethylsilane (BDMADMS) and (N,N-dimethylamino)trimethylsilane (DMATMS) through solution and the vapor phase.

name: pivaldehyde
hypothesis: A branched aliphatic aldehyde binds SiNx -NH2 selectively over SiO2 -OH. The abstract does not name the aldehyde; pivaldehyde is the simplest structure with the -C(CH3)3 group it reports.
falsification: Comparable addition barrier or energy at SiO2 silanols.

literature.title: Selective Gas-Phase Functionalization of SiO2 and SiNx Surfaces with Hydrocarbons
literature.quote: We demonstrate that aldehydes selectively attach to SiNx over SiO2 surfaces, and for the specific branched aliphatic aldehyde used in this work, almost no reaction was detected with the SiO2 surface.

literature.title: Surface etching, chemical modification and characterization of silicon nitride and silicon oxide--selective functionalization of Si3N4 and SiO2
literature.quote: first reacting the -NH2 groups on the etched nitride surface with aldehyde molecules, which do not react with the Si-OH sites on a SiO2 surface

mechanism_note: carbonyl_addition: Si-NH2/Si-OH adds across C=O (hemiaminal/hemiacetal); the later dehydration to the imine reported in the literature is not modelled.

name: glutaraldehyde
hypothesis: Dialdehyde attachment is selective for silicon nitride over silicon oxide.

literature.title: Selective chemical modification of silicon nitride/silicon oxide nanostructures to develop label-free biosensors
literature.quote: the use of glutaraldehyde to selectively immobilize biomolecules only on the silicon nitride part of the chip surface was the most effective

mechanism_note: carbonyl_addition: Si-NH2/Si-OH adds across C=O (hemiaminal/hemiacetal); the later dehydration to the imine reported in the literature is not modelled.

name: N-methyl-aza-2,2,4-trimethylsilacyclopentane
status: mechanism_not_implemented: ring-opening Si-N cleavage keeps one fragment (no byproduct), which the substitution template rejects.
hypothesis: Cyclic azasilanes graft on SiO2 silanols in preference to SiNx amines: a literature reference for the wrong direction.
falsification: Faster grafting on SiNx than on SiO2.

literature.title: Selective Gas-Phase Functionalization of SiO2 and SiNx Surfaces with Hydrocarbons
literature.quote: cyclic azasilanes preferentially react with an -OH-terminated SiO2 surface over a -NHx-terminated SiNx surface with an attachment selectivity of ∼5.4

literature.title: Byproduct-Free Route to Aminosiloxane Monolayers on Silicon/Silicon Dioxide
literature.quote: The chemisorption of N-methyl-aza-2,2,4-trimethylsilacyclopentane from either the solution or the vapor phase produces monolayer films on silicon (oxide) substrates.
